adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, when `refresh_token` is missing it forcefully sets `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"`. In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refreshed token data is then merged into the existing credentials via `o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) };`, so this placeholder value will overwrite the real stored `refresh_token` when Microsoft omits it. The updated credentials are subsequently persisted (via `prisma.credential.update` later in the function), permanently breaking future refreshes.
